Explore it or watch it

From your walk to their browser.

One space, four steps. You walk it with the phone; Veylet builds and checks the walkthrough automatically; nothing is shared until you approve it.

  1. Walk the space with the phone upright. At each spot, turn until the ring closes; the app flags anything it still needs before you finish.

  2. Finish and check the saved route. Send from the app: it uploads in the background. Check your account for rendering status.

  3. Veylet builds the walkthrough. We’ll email you when it’s ready. An automatic quality check stops a render that cannot work, such as one with no usable photos or depth, and asks for a recapture of the rooms it names; anything else it finds is flagged as worth a look for you to check before you approve. A capture that cannot be used is never counted.

  4. Review the exact version on your phone, then share a link or a website embed. Viewers need no app or account; revoking stops new access.

Before you write.

What does a walkthrough cost?

1 free month from the day you activate the plan, with 3 accepted walkthroughs included; the first charge is on the day it ends, and cancelling before then charges nothing. Then the Veylet plan, monthly or annual. Monthly is A$139.99 a month in the App Store, with 2 accepted walkthroughs a month; unused ones roll over, up to 4 banked. Annual is A$1,399.99 upfront a year in the App Store: the same 24 walkthroughs a year, to use any time in the plan year, for A$279.89 (16.7%) less than 12 monthly payments. For busier months, add a pack of 3 walkthroughs for A$169 or 10 for A$499, each valid 12 months; for a fast one, a Super fast render is A$29, ready in about 30 minutes, any day, any time, or refunded, sold only while its availability gate is green. Seats are unlimited, hosting, link and embed are included, and every released walkthrough stays live while you subscribe. If your first walkthrough isn’t listing-ready, we redo it free. App Store subscriptions renew unless cancelled through Apple; studio invoices follow your written agreement. The offer page itemises your first year. Joining the waitlist is free.

Can I see a real customer example?

We do not yet have a client-accepted tour to show. Our captures are still under quality review. The room images and animations here are labelled illustrations. Veylet support can tell you what has been tested so far.

Does joining the waitlist create an account or take payment?

No. Joining the waitlist creates no account and takes no payment. Anyone can join the waitlist; new accounts are admitted in weekly groups and sign in with the email they joined with.
